verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a 2FA authenticator and API, since bulk import, export, or management of many tokens is plausible, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any bulk capability: the documented features (sync, backup, per-device rename and remove, one-at-a-time QR capture) are all single-item. Community reports describe the opposite, with no bulk export and manual migrations taking hours.
